line_art_thickness_scan.method: a distance map from every black pixel to the nearest white pixel, then a cluster scan of the pixels deeper than 20 px; a stroke wider than 40 px would show up as a cluster
line_art_thickness_scan.cover: only the four eye pupils are deeper than 20 px; the deepest pupil measures 63 px from the pupil centre to its edge

line_gap_scan.method: a distance map from every white pixel to the nearest black pixel, then a scan of the closed white areas that are thinner than 15 px
line_gap_scan.result: the thin closed areas all sit between two parallel strokes of the play equipment, or between a pupil and its eye ring; the narrowest one measures 2 px and the rest measure 5 to 14 px; no gap sits inside a face or a hand
line_gap_scan.judgement: no line gap makes the coloring hard
